title.zh: 卷十六 本紀第十六 武宗
title.raw: 卷十六 本紀第十六 武宗 Volume 16 Annals 16: Wuzong

sentences.zh: 【武宗】

translations.literal: Wuzong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong.

sentences.zh: 武宗，承天達道英肅睿哲昭德顯功弘文思孝毅皇帝，諱厚照，孝宗長子也。

translations.literal: The Wuzong Emperor, Bearing Heaven, Penetrating the Way, Sagely, Solemn, Sagacious, Illuminating in Virtue, Manifest in Achievement, Expansive in Culture, Reflective in Filial Piety, and Resolute, taboo name Houzhao, was the Xiaozong Emperor's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong—honored after death as one who bore Heaven, penetrated the Way, and united sagely solemnity, sagacious illumination, manifest achievement, expansive culture, reflective filial piety, and resolute purpose—was named Zhu Houzhao and was the eldest son of Emperor Xiaozong.

sentences.zh: 母孝康敬皇后。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Xiaokangjing.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Xiaokangjing.

sentences.zh: 弘治五年，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In Hongzhi year five he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi five he was formally named crown prince.

sentences.zh: 性聰穎，好騎射。

translations.literal: By nature he was quick-witted and fond of riding and archery.
translations.idiomatic: He was clever by nature and devoted to riding and archery.

sentences.zh: 十八年五月，孝宗崩。

translations.literal: In year eighteen, fifth month, the Xiaozong Emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongzhi eighteen Emperor Xiaozong died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Day renyin: he assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhu Houzhao ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 以明年為正德元年，大赦天下，除弘治十六年以前逋賦。

translations.literal: The coming year was made Zhengde year one; great pardon under Heaven; arrears in tax and grain levies before Hongzhi sixteen were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: The following year was declared the first year of the Zhengde reign; a general amnesty was proclaimed; and tax and grain arrears dating before Hongzhi sixteen were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊申，小王子犯宣府，總兵官張俊敗績。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the Little Prince raided Xuanfu; Regional Commander Zhang Jun was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Little Prince struck Xuanfu and routed Regional Commander Zhang Jun.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太監苗逵監督軍務，保國公硃暉為征虜將軍，充總兵官，右都御史史琳提督軍務，禦之。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the eunuch Miao Kui supervised military affairs; the Defender of the State Zhu Hui was made General Who Subdues the Barbarians and filled the post of regional commander; Right Censor-in-Chief Shi Lin supervised military affairs—to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the eunuch Miao Kui was put in charge of the campaign, Defender of the State Zhu Hui was named General Who Subdues the Barbarians and overall commander, and Right Censor-in-Chief Shi Lin directed operations against the invader.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲寅，尊皇太后為太皇太后，皇后為皇太后。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day jiayin: the empress dowager was honored Grand Empress Dowager and the empress was honored Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on jiayin, the empress dowager was elevated to grand empress dowager and the empress was made empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 丙子，召硃暉等還。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Zhu Hui and the others were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Zhu Hui and his command were ordered home.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，南京地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu: Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiawu, Nanjing was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，振陝西饑。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: famine relief was distributed in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the court sent famine relief to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，小王子犯甘肅。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingchen: the Little Prince raided Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingchen, the Little Prince raided Gansu.

sentences.zh: 庚午，葬敬皇帝于泰陵。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the Respectful Emperor was buried at Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the late Xiaozong Emperor was buried at Tailing.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，禦文華殿日講。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiashen: daily lectures were held at the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiashen, the emperor attended daily lectures in the Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、安南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Champa and Annam sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 正德元年春正月乙酉，享太廟。

translations.literal: Zhengde year one, spring, first month, day yiyou: the Grand Ancestral Temple was offered sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhengde, in the first month of spring, on yiyou, he offered sacrifice at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，禦經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day renzi: the Classics Lecture was attended.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi, he attended the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，耕耤田。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the Ploughing Ceremony was performed at the Sacred Field.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he performed the ceremonial ploughing at the Sacred Field.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，釋奠于先師孔子。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiashen: the libation sacrifice to the First Teacher Confucius was performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiashen, he offered the libation sacrifice to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙申，減蘇、杭織造歲幣。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day bingshen: the annual quota for Suzhou and Hangzhou imperial weaving was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on bingshen, the court cut the annual Suzhou and Hangzhou weaving levy.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，禁吏民奢靡。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinyou: officials and commoners were forbidden extravagant display.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinyou, luxury among officials and commoners was banned.

sentences.zh: 免陝西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Tax grain in disaster-stricken Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tax grain was forgiven in disaster-hit Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是日，大風雨壞郊壇獸瓦。

translations.literal: That day, great wind and rain destroyed the animal-tile ornaments of the suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: That same day a violent storm shattered the animal figures on the suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 庚午，諭群臣修省。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the assembled ministers were instructed to practice self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the emperor ordered his ministers to undertake court-wide self-examination.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙卯，復遣內官南京織造。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day yimao: palace eunuchs were again sent to supervise weaving at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on yimao, the court again dispatched inner eunuchs to run the Nanjing imperial workshops.

sentences.zh: 戊午，立皇后夏氏。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Lady Xia was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Lady Xia was enthroned as empress.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，戶部尚書韓文帥廷臣請誅亂政內臣馬永成等八人，大學士劉健、李東陽、謝遷主之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingsi: Minister of Revenue Han Wen led the court in requesting execution of the eight inner officials who had thrown government into disorder—Ma Yongcheng and the rest—with Grand Secretaries Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian taking the lead.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingsi, Minister of Revenue Han Wen led the court in demanding the execution of eight disordering eunuchs led by Ma Yongcheng; Grand Secretaries Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian headed the memorial.

sentences.zh: 戊午，韓文等再請，不聽。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Han Wen and the others memorialized again; the throne did not assent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Han Wen and his allies petitioned again; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 以劉瑾掌司禮監，丘聚、谷大用提督東、西廠，張永督十二團營兼神機營，魏彬督三千營，各據要地。

translations.literal: Liu Jin was put in charge of the Directorate of Ceremonial; Qiu Ju and Gu Dayong supervised the Eastern and Western Depots; Zhang Yong supervised the Twelve Barracks and also the Divine Engine Corps; Wei Bin supervised the Three Thousand Barracks—each holding a key post.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jin took the Directorate of Ceremonial; Qiu Ju and Gu Dayong ran the Eastern and Western Depots; Zhang Yong commanded the Twelve Barracks and the Divine Engine Corps; Wei Bin commanded the Three Thousand Barracks—each seizing a choke point of power.

sentences.zh: 劉健、李東陽、謝遷乞去，健、遷是日致仕。

translations.literal: Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian begged to retire; Jian and Qian retired that day.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian asked to resign; Liu Jian and Xie Qian left office that same day.

sentences.zh: 己未，東陽復乞去，不允。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Dongyang again begged to retire; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Dongyang again asked to resign; the throne would not release him.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，吏部尚書焦芳兼文淵閣大學士，吏部侍郎王鏊兼翰林學士，入閣預機務。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Minister of Personnel Jiao Fang was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion; Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Ao was concurrently made Hanlin Academician; both entered the Grand Secretariat to deliberate on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Minister of Personnel Jiao Fang joined the Grand Secretariat as Wenyuan grand secretary, and Vice Minister Wang Ao entered as Hanlin academician; both took up deliberation of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，停日講。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: daily lectures were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen daily lectures were halted.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，罷韓文。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiachen: Han Wen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, Han Wen was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，命錦衣衛官點閱給事中。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingsi: Brocade Guard officers were ordered to inspect and review supervising secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, Brocade Guard officers were ordered to audit the supervising secretaries.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，除曲阜孔氏田賦。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: land tax for the Kong clan of Qufu was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou land tax owed by the Kong clan of Qufu was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 是年，哈密、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Hami and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hami and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day yihai, new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the new moon yihai of the first month of spring, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚戌，杖給事中艾洪、呂翀、劉蒨及南京給事中戴銑、御史薄彥徽等二十一人于闕下。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day gengxu: supervising secretaries Ai Hong, Lü Chong, Liu Qian, and Nanjing supervising secretaries Dai Xian, Censor Bo Yanhui, and twenty others were beaten with the rod below the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengxu, supervising secretaries Ai Hong, Lü Chong, and Liu Qian, with Nanjing colleagues Dai Xian and Censor Bo Yanhui and twenty others, were flogged at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，杖御史王良臣於午門，御史王時中荷校於都察院。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuxu: Censor Wang Liangchen was beaten at the Meridian Gate; Censor Wang Shizhong was yoked and displayed at the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuxu, Censor Wang Liangchen was flogged at the Meridian Gate and Censor Wang Shizhong was paraded in the cangue at the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，以大學士劉健、謝遷，尚書韓文、楊守隨、張敷華、林瀚五十三人党比，宣戒群臣。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinwei: because Grand Secretaries Liu Jian and Xie Qian and Ministers Han Wen, Yang Shousui, Zhang Fuhua, and Lin Han—fifty-three men in all—had formed a faction, an edict admonished the assembled ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, an edict rebuked the court for factionalism, naming Grand Secretaries Liu Jian and Xie Qian and Ministers Han Wen, Yang Shousui, Zhang Fuhua, and Lin Han among fifty-three men.

sentences.zh: 是月，敕各鎮守太監預刑名政事。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered garrison eunuchs at each post to intervene in criminal cases and government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That month the throne ordered military eunuchs at every garrison to take part in criminal trials and local administration.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊午，度僧道四萬人。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day wuwu: forty thousand Buddhist and Daoist clergy were ordained.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wuwu, forty thousand Buddhist and Daoist clergy received ordination.

sentences.zh: 己巳，復甯王宸濠護衛。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the Princely Establishment guard of the Prince of Ning, Zhu Chenhao, was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the personal guard of Prince of Ning Zhu Chenhao was restored.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，孝宗神主祔太廟。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiaxu: the Xiaozong Emperor's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Emperor Xiaozong's spirit tablet was placed in the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷修邊垣，輸其費于京師。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: repair of the frontier walls was halted and the funds were sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin work on the frontier walls was stopped and the appropriation was diverted to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙戌，作豹房。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day bingxu: the Leopard House was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on bingxu, the Leopard House was constructed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，逮各邊巡撫都御史及管糧郎中下獄。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiashen: frontier grand coordinators and grain-supply officials were arrested and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiashen, frontier grand coordinators and grain officials were thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，南京戶部尚書楊廷和為文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Yang Tinghe, vice minister of revenue at Nanjing, was made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and deliberated on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Yang Tinghe, Nanjing vice minister of revenue, entered the Grand Secretariat as Wenyuan grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，開浙江、福建、四川銀礦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renchen: silver mines were opened in Zhejiang, Fujian, and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renchen, the court opened silver mines in Zhejiang, Fujian, and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day dingwei: the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the first month of spring, on dingwei, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大計外吏，中旨罷翰林學士吳儼、御史楊南金。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the triennial evaluation of outer officials was held; by secret edict Hanlin Academician Wu Yan and Censor Yang Nanjin were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the triennial review of provincial officials was held; by secret edict Hanlin Academician Wu Yan and Censor Yang Nanjin were removed.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，令京官告假違限及病滿一年者皆致仕。

translations.literal: Second month, day jisi: capital officials who overstayed leave or remained on sick leave a full year were all made to retire.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jisi, capital officials who exceeded leave limits or had been ill a full year were forced to retire.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，賜呂柟等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day yimao: Lü Nan and other metropolitan graduates were granted jinshi and other degrees in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao, Lü Nan and other metropolitan graduates received jinshi and lower degrees in due order.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，軍民納銀，得授都指揮僉事以下官。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yihai: soldiers and commoners who paid silver could be appointed to posts from vice commander of the guard down.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yihai, military men and civilians who paid silver could buy appointments as low as vice commander of the guard.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，得匿名文書于禦道，跪群臣奉天門外詰之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen: an anonymous document was found on the imperial roadway; the ministers knelt outside the Gate of Heavenly Felicity to be interrogated.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen, an anonymous placard was found on the imperial roadway and the ministers were made to kneel outside the Gate of Heavenly Felicity for questioning.

sentences.zh: 下三百余人於錦衣衛獄，尋釋之。

translations.literal: More than three hundred men were sent down to the Brocade Guard prison; shortly they were released.
translations.idiomatic: Over three hundred men were cast into the Brocade Guard prison and soon afterward freed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，命天下選樂工送京師。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renzi: the realm was ordered to select musicians and send them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renzi, the throne ordered every province to choose musicians for Beijing.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，立內廠，劉瑾領之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinsi: an inner depot was established; Liu Jin headed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinsi, an inner depot was founded under Liu Jin's control.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，下韓文錦衣衛獄，罰輸米千石於大同。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Han Wen was sent down to the Brocade Guard prison and fined one thousand piculs of grain payable at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Han Wen was imprisoned in the Brocade Guard and fined one thousand piculs of grain to be delivered at Datong.

sentences.zh: 是月，山東盜起。

translations.literal: That month, bandits rose in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That month bandit gangs appeared in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，削致仕尚書雍泰、馬文升、許進、劉大夏籍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day maoyin: the registers of retired ministers Yong Tai, Ma Wensheng, Xu Jin, and Liu Daxia were struck.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on maoyin, the official registers of retired ministers Yong Tai, Ma Wensheng, Xu Jin, and Liu Daxia were expunged.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，逮劉大夏下獄，戍肅州。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Liu Daxia was arrested and imprisoned and banished to Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Liu Daxia was arrested, jailed, and exiled to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，振南京饑。

translations.literal: Day guihai: famine relief was distributed in Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the court sent famine relief to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，南京工部侍郎畢亨振湖廣、河南饑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinwei: Bi Heng, vice minister of works at Nanjing, distributed relief for famine in Huguang and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinwei, Nanjing vice minister of works Bi Heng relieved famine in Huguang and Henan.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，振鳳陽諸府饑。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiwei: famine relief was distributed in the prefectures of Fengyang and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiwei, relief was sent to famine-stricken Fengyang and neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、哈密、撒馬兒罕、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam, Hami, Samarkand, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, Hami, Samarkand, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day bingwu: the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the first month of spring, on bingwu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，削劉健、謝遷籍。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu: the registers of Liu Jian and Xie Qian were struck.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingxu, Liu Jian and Xie Qian were expunged from the official rolls.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，振浙江饑。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiachen: famine relief was distributed in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiachen, famine relief was sent to Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，吏部侍郎張彩請不時考察京官，從之。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Vice Minister of Personnel Zhang Cai requested irregular evaluation of capital officials; assented.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Vice Minister Zhang Cai asked that capital officials be reviewed outside the regular schedule; the throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，王鏊致仕。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yihai: Wang Ao retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yihai, Wang Ao left office.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，吏部尚書劉宇兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuzi: Minister of Personnel Liu Yu was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and deliberated on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi, Minister of Personnel Liu Yu joined the Grand Secretariat as Wenyuan grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛酉，遣使核各邊屯田。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day xinyou: envoys were dispatched to audit garrison farmland on each frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on xinyou, envoys were sent to inspect military colony lands on every frontier.

sentences.zh: 是月，義州軍變。

translations.literal: That month, the Yizhou garrison mutinied.
translations.idiomatic: That month the troops at Yizhou mutinied.

sentences.zh: 閏九月，小王子犯延綏，圍總兵官吳江于隴州城。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month: the Little Prince raided Yan-sui and besieged Regional Commander Wu Jiang in Longzhou city.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month the Little Prince struck Yan-sui and penned Regional Commander Wu Jiang inside Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲子，犯花馬池，總制尚書才寬戰死。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day jiazi: he raided Huamachi; Grand Coordinator Cai Kuan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiazi, he raided Huamachi and Grand Coordinator Cai Kuan was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，奪劉健、謝遷等六百七十五人誥敕。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu: patent letters of enfeoffment were stripped from Liu Jian, Xie Qian, and six hundred seventy-five others.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengxu, patents of honor were revoked from Liu Jian, Xie Qian, and six hundred seventy-five others.

sentences.zh: 是年，兩廣、江西、湖廣、陝西、四川並盜起。

translations.literal: That year, bandits rose together in Guangdong and Guangxi, Jiangxi, Huguang, Shaanxi, and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: That year bandit uprisings broke out across Guangdong and Guangxi, Jiangxi, Huguang, Shaanxi, and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 琉球、安南、哈密、土魯番、撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu, Annam, Hami, Turfan, and Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu, Annam, Hami, Turfan, and Samarkand sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Year five, spring, first month, day dingmao: the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the first month of spring, on dingmao, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，籍故尚書秦紘家。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the household of the late Minister Qin Hong was registered for confiscation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the property of the late Minister Qin Hong was inventoried for seizure.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，兵部尚書曹元為吏部尚書兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Second month, day guisi: Minister of War Cao Yuan was made Minister of Personnel and concurrently Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and deliberated on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guisi, Minister of War Cao Yuan became minister of personnel and Wenyuan grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，禱雨，釋獄囚，免正德三年逋賦。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinwei: rain was prayed for; prisoners were released; arrears in tax and grain levies of Zhengde three were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, the court prayed for rain, freed prisoners, and forgave tax and grain arrears from Zhengde three.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，江西賊熾，右都御史王哲巡視南、贛，刑部尚書洪鐘總制川、陝、河南、鄖陽軍務兼振恤湖廣。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: bandits in Jiangxi grew fierce; Right Censor-in-Chief Wang Zhe inspected Nan and Gan; Minister of Punishments Hong Zhong took overall command of military affairs in Sichuan, Shaanxi, Henan, and Yunyang and also directed famine relief in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Jiangxi banditry flared; Right Censor-in-Chief Wang Zhe was sent to inspect southern Gan, and Minister of Punishments Hong Zhong was given overall command on the Sichuan-Shaanxi-Henan-Yunyang front while relieving famine in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，安化王寘鐇反，殺巡撫都御史安惟學、總兵官姜漢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengyin: the Prince of Anhua, Zhu Zhifan, rebelled and killed Grand Coordinator An Weixue and Regional Commander Jiang Han.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengyin, Prince of Anhua Zhu Zhifan rose in rebellion and killed Grand Coordinator An Weixue and Regional Commander Jiang Han.

sentences.zh: 丙午，起右都御史楊一清總制寧夏、延綏、甘、涼軍務，涇陽伯神英充總兵官，討寘鐇。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Right Censor-in-Chief Yang Yiqing was raised to overall command of military affairs in Ningxia, Yan-sui, Gansu, and Liang; the Earl of Divine Valor Shen Ying filled the post of regional commander—to suppress Zhifan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Right Censor-in-Chief Yang Yiqing was recalled to overall command in Ningxia, Yan-sui, Gansu, and Liang, and Earl of Divine Valor Shen Ying was named regional commander to crush Zhu Zhifan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: an edict proclaimed pardon under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 太監張永總督寧夏軍務。

translations.literal: The eunuch Zhang Yong took overall supervision of Ningxia military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Zhang Yong was placed in overall charge of the Ningxia campaign.

sentences.zh: 是日，遊擊將軍仇鉞襲執寘鐇，寧夏平。

translations.literal: That day, Guerrilla General Qiu Yue raided and seized Zhifan; Ningxia was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Guerrilla General Qiu Yue stormed Zhu Zhifan's camp and took him prisoner; Ningxia was pacified.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，焦芳致仕。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiwei: Jiao Fang retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiwei, Jiao Fang left office.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，帝自號大慶法王，所司鑄印以進。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengzi: the Emperor styled himself the Great Celebration Dharma King; the responsible office cast a seal and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengzi, the emperor took the title Great Celebration Dharma King and had the appropriate office cast and present a seal.

sentences.zh: 丙午，劉宇罷。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Liu Yu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Liu Yu was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，洪鐘討沔陽賊，平之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen: Hong Zhong campaigned against the bandits of Mianyang and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renshen, Hong Zhong attacked the Mianyang bandits and suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，劉瑾以謀反下獄。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiawu: Liu Jin was imprisoned on a charge of plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiawu, Liu Jin was thrown into prison for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 詔自正德二年後所更政令悉如舊。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that all government measures changed after Zhengde year two should revert to the former practice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that every policy altered after Zhengde two would be restored to the old order.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，治劉瑾黨，吏部尚書張彩下獄。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Liu Jin's faction was punished; Minister of Personnel Zhang Cai was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the court moved against Liu Jin's party and imprisoned Minister of Personnel Zhang Cai.

sentences.zh: 己亥，曹元罷。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Cao Yuan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Cao Yuan was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丁未，革甯王護衛。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the guard of the Prince of Ning was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the personal guard of the Prince of Ning was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊申，劉瑾伏誅。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Liu Jin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Liu Jin was put to death.

sentences.zh: 己酉，釋謫戍諸臣。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: officials banished to frontier garrison duty were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou officials exiled to frontier garrison service were freed.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，論平寘鐇功，封仇鉞咸甯伯。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingchen: merit in pacifying Zhifan was assessed; Qiu Yue was enfeoffed Earl of Xianning.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingchen, rewards were granted for pacifying Zhu Zhifan, and Qiu Yue was made Earl of Xianning.

sentences.zh: 戊午，吏部尚書劉忠、梁儲並兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Ministers of Personnel Liu Zhong and Liang Chu were concurrently made Grand Secretaries of the Wenyuan Pavilion and deliberated on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Liu Zhong and Liang Chu, both ministers of personnel, entered the Grand Secretariat as Wenyuan grand secretaries and took up deliberation of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 己未，以平寘鐇、劉瑾功，封太監張永兄富、弟容皆為伯。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: for merit in pacifying Zhifan and Liu Jin, the eunuch Zhang Yong's elder brother Fu and younger brother Rong were both enfeoffed as earls.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, for crushing Zhu Zhifan and Liu Jin, Zhang Yong's elder brother Fu and younger brother Rong were both enfeoffed as earls.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封義子指揮同知硃德、太監谷大用兄大寬、馬永成兄山、魏彬弟英皆為伯。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the adopted son Commander Zhu De, the eunuch Gu Dayong's brother Dakuan, Ma Yongcheng's brother Shan, and Wei Bin's younger brother Ying were all enfeoffed as earls.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the adopted son Commander Zhu De, Gu Dayong's brother Dakuan, Ma Yongcheng's brother Shan, and Wei Bin's younger brother Ying were all made earls.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，戮張彩屍於市。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jihai: Zhang Cai's corpse was dismembered in the market.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jihai, Zhang Cai's corpse was hacked apart in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，賊陷江津，僉事吳景死之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jichou: bandits took Jiangjin; Assistant Administration Commissioner Wu Jing died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jichou, bandits seized Jiangjin and Assistant Commissioner Wu Jing was killed.

sentences.zh: 是年，日本、占城、哈密、撒馬兒罕、土魯番、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Japan, Champa, Hami, Samarkand, Turfan, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys came with tribute from Japan, Champa, Hami, Samarkand, Turfan, and U-Tsang.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月甲子，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Year six, spring, first month, day jiazi: the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in year six, on jiazi, the emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賊陷營山，殺僉事王源。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: bandits took Yingshan and killed Assistant Commissioner Wang Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou bandits overran Yingshan and killed Assistant Commissioner Wang Yuan.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，寘鐇伏誅。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingchen: Zhifan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingchen, Zhu Zhifan was executed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，起左都御史陳金總制江西軍務討賊。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Left Censor-in-Chief Chen Jin was recalled to overall command of Jiangxi military affairs to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Left Censor-in-Chief Chen Jin was raised from retirement to overall command in Jiangxi and ordered to crush the bandits.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，賜楊慎等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuchen: Yang Shen and other metropolitan graduates were granted jinshi and other degrees in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuchen, Yang Shen and other metropolitan graduates received jinshi and lower degrees in due order.

sentences.zh: 庚午，惠安伯張偉充總兵官，右都御史馬中錫提督軍務，討直隸、河南、山東賊。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Earl of Hui'an Zhang Wei filled the post of regional commander; Right Censor-in-Chief Ma Zhongxi supervised military affairs—to campaign against bandits in Zhili, Henan, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Earl of Hui'an Zhang Wei was named regional commander and Right Censor-in-Chief Ma Zhongxi directed operations against bandits in Zhili, Henan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免被寇州縣稅糧一年。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: tax grain was remitted for one year in prefectures and counties ravaged by invasion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi grain levies were forgiven for one year in prefectures and counties the bandits had ravaged.

sentences.zh: 是月，小王子入河套，犯沿邊諸堡。

translations.literal: That month the Little Prince entered the Ordos bend and attacked frontier forts along the border.
translations.idiomatic: That same month the Little Prince entered the Ordos bend and struck frontier forts all along the line.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，劉忠乞省墓歸。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiwei: Liu Zhong begged leave to visit family tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guiwei, Liu Zhong asked permission to return home and tend the ancestral graves.

sentences.zh: 是月，淮安盜起。

translations.literal: That month bandits rose in Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: That month banditry broke out in Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 六月，山西盜起。

translations.literal: Sixth month: bandits rose in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month bandits rose in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，賊犯文安，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen: bandits struck Wen'an; the capital went on alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renshen, bandits attacked Wen'an and the capital was placed on alert.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，調宣府、延綏兵入援。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: troops from Xuanfu and Yan-sui were shifted to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou troops from Xuanfu and Yan-sui were called in to reinforce the capital.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，兵部侍郎陸完將邊軍討賊。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jimao: Vice Minister of War Lu Wan led frontier troops against the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jimao, Vice Minister of War Lu Wan took frontier troops into the field against the bandits.

sentences.zh: 四川巡撫都御史林俊擒斬賊首藍廷瑞、鄢本恕。

translations.literal: Sichuan Grand Coordinator Lin Jun captured and executed the bandit chiefs Lan Tingrui and Yan Benshu.
translations.idiomatic: In Sichuan Grand Coordinator Lin Jun captured and beheaded the bandit leaders Lan Tingrui and Yan Benshu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賊劉六犯固安。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the bandit Liu Liu attacked Gu'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the bandit Liu Liu struck Gu'an.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，召張偉、馬中錫還。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Zhang Wei and Ma Zhongxi were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhang Wei and Ma Zhongxi were ordered home.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，再調宣府及遼東兵益陸完軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingyin: more troops from Xuanfu and Liaodong were added to Lu Wan's army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingyin, fresh troops from Xuanfu and Liaodong were sent to reinforce Lu Wan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，賊陷長山，典史李暹戰死。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiwei: bandits took Changshan; Records Clerk Li Xian died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guiwei, bandits seized Changshan and Records Clerk Li Xian fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賊焚糧艘于濟寧州。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: bandits burned grain barges at Jining prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen bandits burned grain transports at Jining.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，甘州副總兵白琮敗小王子于柴溝。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Gansu Vice Regional Commander Bai Cong defeated the Little Prince at Chaigou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Vice Regional Commander Bai Cong of Gansu routed the Little Prince at Chaigou.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，太監谷大用、張忠、伏羌伯毛銳帥京軍會陸完討賊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengxu: the eunuchs Gu Dayong and Zhang Zhong and Baron of Fuxiang Mao Rui led capital troops to join Lu Wan against the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengxu, the eunuchs Gu Dayong and Zhang Zhong and Baron of Fuxiang Mao Rui led capital armies to join Lu Wan against the bandits.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，戶部侍郎叢蘭、王瓊振兩畿、河南、山東。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Vice Ministers of Revenue Cong Lan and Wang Qiong provided relief in the two metropolitan circuits, Henan, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Vice Ministers Cong Lan and Wang Qiong of Revenue were sent to relieve famine in the two metropolitan regions, Henan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 戊午，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the capital was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，敕修省。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: an edict commanded self-examination and austerity.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict ordered officials to examine their conduct and practice austerity.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，瘞暴骨。

translations.literal: Day yihai: exposed bones were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the court ordered the burial of unburied corpses.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，禮部尚書費宏兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guisi: Minister of Rites Fei Hong was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and deliberated on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guisi, Minister of Rites Fei Hong joined the Grand Secretariat as Wenyuan grand secretary and took up deliberation of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲午，清河口至柳鋪，黃河清三日。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: from Qinghe mouth to Liupu the Yellow River ran clear for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Yellow River ran clear from Qinghe mouth to Liupu for three days.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賊掠蒼溪，兵備副使馮傑敗死。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: bandits raided Cangxi; Vice Commissioner for Military Preparedness Feng Jie was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou bandits raided Cangxi and Vice Commissioner Feng Jie was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 是年，自畿輔迄江、淮、楚、蜀，盜賊殺官吏，山東尤甚，至破九十余城，道路梗絕。

translations.literal: That year, from the metropolitan region to the Yangtze-Huai, Chu, and Shu, bandits killed officials; Shandong suffered worst, with more than ninety cities broken and roads severed.
translations.idiomatic: That year, from the capital districts through the Yangtze-Huai, Chu, and Shu, bandits killed officials; Shandong was worst hit, with more than ninety cities overrun and travel cut off.

sentences.zh: 琉球、哈密入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu and Hami sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu and Hami sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲寅，賊犯霸州，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Year seven, spring, first month, day jiayin: bandits struck Bazhou; the capital went on alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in year seven, on jiayin, bandits attacked Bazhou and the capital was placed on alert.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，陷大城，知縣張汝舟、主簿李銓戰死。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: they took Dacheng; Magistrate Zhang Ruzhou and Registrar Li Quan died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the bandits seized Dacheng; Magistrate Zhang Ruzhou and Registrar Li Quan were killed fighting.

sentences.zh: 己未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，副都御史彭澤、咸甯伯仇鉞提督軍務，太監陸訚監軍，討河南賊。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou: Vice Censor-in-Chief Peng Ze and Earl of Xianning Qiu Yue supervised military affairs; the eunuch Lu Yang supervised the army—to campaign against Henan bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingchou, Vice Censor-in-Chief Peng Ze and Earl of Xianning Qiu Yue directed operations against the Henan bandits while the eunuch Lu Yang oversaw the army.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賊犯萊州，指揮僉事蔡顯等力戰死。

translations.literal: Day jimao: bandits struck Laizhou; Commander Cai Xian and others fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao bandits attacked Laizhou; Commander Cai Xian and others fought to the end and fell.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，副總兵時源敗績于河南，都督僉事馮禎力戰死。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinwei: Vice Regional Commander Shi Yuan was defeated in Henan; Assistant Regional Commander Feng Zhen fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, Vice Regional Commander Shi Yuan was routed in Henan and Assistant Regional Commander Feng Zhen was killed fighting.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙午，陸完敗賊於萊州，山東賊平。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day bingwu: Lu Wan defeated bandits at Laizhou; Shandong bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on bingwu, Lu Wan crushed the bandits at Laizhou and Shandong was pacified.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，左都御史陳金討平撫州賊。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Left Censor-in-Chief Chen Jin pacified the Fuzhou bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Left Censor-in-Chief Chen Jin suppressed the bandits in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賊殺副都御史馬炳然于武昌江中。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: bandits killed Vice Censor-in-Chief Ma Bingran on the Yangtze at Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin bandits killed Vice Censor-in-Chief Ma Bingran on the river at Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬辰，仇鉞敗賊於光山，河南賊平。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day renchen: Qiu Yue defeated bandits at Guangshan; Henan bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renchen, Qiu Yue routed the bandits at Guangshan and Henan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，江西賊殺副使周憲于華林。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guisi: Jiangxi bandits killed Vice Commissioner Zhou Xian at Hualin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guisi, Jiangxi bandits killed Vice Commissioner Zhou Xian at Hualin.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，振四川饑。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: famine relief was distributed in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the court sent famine relief to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，陸完追殲劉七等賊於狼山。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guihai: Lu Wan pursued and annihilated Liu Qi and other bandits at Langshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guihai, Lu Wan pursued and wiped out Liu Qi and his followers at Langshan.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，陳金討平華林賊。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiyou: Chen Jin pacified the Hualin bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiyou, Chen Jin suppressed the Hualin bandits.

translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he came back from Changping.

sentences.zh: 戊午，夜視朝。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: he held court at night.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he held a night audience.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，副都御史吳廷舉振湖廣饑。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Vice Censor-in-Chief Wu Tingju relieved famine in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Vice Censor-in-Chief Wu Tingju distributed famine relief in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，夜微服出德勝門，如居庸關。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: at night he went out incognito through Desheng Gate toward Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, at night, he slipped out of Desheng Gate toward Juyong Pass in disguise.

sentences.zh: 辛未，出關，幸宣府，命穀大用守關，毋出京朝官。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: he passed through the pass, visited Xuanfu, and ordered Gu Dayong to hold the pass and forbid capital officials from leaving the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he left the pass, went to Xuanfu, and ordered Gu Dayong to guard the gate and keep capital officials from leaving Beijing.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，河決城武。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day xinmao: the Yellow River breached its banks at Chengwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao, the Yellow River broke through at Chengwu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，如陽和，自稱總督軍務威武大將軍總兵官。

translations.literal: Day renchen: he went to Yanghe and styled himself Supreme Commander of Military Affairs, Valiant-and-Awesome Grand General, and Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he went to Yanghe and took the title Supreme Commander of Military Affairs, Valiant-and-Awesome Grand General, and Commander-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 庚子，輸帑銀一百萬兩于宣府。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: one million taels of treasury silver were delivered to Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi one million taels of treasury silver were sent to Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，駐蹕順聖川。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, day guimao: the Emperor halted at Shunsheng River.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guimao, the emperor encamped at Shunsheng River.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，小王子犯陽和，掠應州。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the Little Prince raided Yanghe and plundered Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Little Prince struck Yanghe and raided Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，親督諸軍禦之，戰五日。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the Emperor personally directed the armies in defense; battle lasted five days.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the emperor personally led the armies in defense; fighting lasted five days.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，寇引去，駐蹕大同。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the raiders withdrew; the Emperor halted at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the raiders withdrew and the emperor encamped at Datong.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，召楊廷和復入閣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day dinghai: Yang Tinghe was recalled to the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dinghai, Yang Tinghe was recalled to the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊子，還至宣府。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: he returned to Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he returned to Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，群臣赴行在請還宮，不得出關而還。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day guihai: the officials went to the traveling palace to beg him to return to the capital; unable to pass the pass, they turned back.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guihai, officials came to the traveling palace to beg him to return to the capital; barred from the pass, they went back.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁亥，迎春于宣府。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, day dinghai: the spring welcoming ceremony was held at Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dinghai, the spring welcoming rite was held at Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu and U-Tsang presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu and U-Tsang sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月辛丑朔，帝在宣府。

translations.literal: On the xinchou new moon of the first month of spring in Zhengde year thirteen the Emperor was at Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the first month in Zhengde thirteen the emperor was still at Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 丙午，至自宣府，命群臣具彩帳、羊酒郊迎，禦帳殿受賀。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: he returned from Xuanfu, ordered officials to prepare colored tents, sheep, and wine for a suburban welcome, and received congratulations in the tent hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he returned from Xuanfu, commanded officials to ready colored tents, sheep, and wine for a suburban welcome, and received congratulations in the tent hall.

sentences.zh: 丁未，罷南郊致齋。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: fasting before the southern suburban sacrifice was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the court ended the southern suburban fast.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大祀天地於南郊，遂獵于南海子。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Heaven and Earth were grandly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb; he then hunted at the Nanhai Park.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he performed the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth, then hunted in the Nanhai Park.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，還宮。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，復如宣府。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: he again went to Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he went to Xuanfu again.

sentences.zh: 是月，振兩畿、山東水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood-stricken areas in the two Metropolitan Regions and Shandong were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood relief was sent to the two metropolitan regions and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 給京師流民米，人三鬥。

translations.literal: Grain was issued to refugees in the capital, three pecks per person.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees in the capital were given grain, three pecks each.

sentences.zh: 瘞死者。

translations.literal: The dead were buried.
translations.idiomatic: The unburied dead were interred.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，太皇太后崩。

translations.literal: In the second month, day jimao: the Grand Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jimao, the Grand Empress Dowager died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至自宣府。

translations.literal: Day rewu: he returned from Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On rewu he returned from Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，如昌平。

translations.literal: In the third month, day wuchen: he went to Changping.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuchen, he went to Changping.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳朔，謁六陵，遂幸密雲。

translations.literal: On the jisi new moon of the fourth summer month he visited the six mausoleums, then proceeded to Miyun.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the fourth summer month he visited the six imperial tombs, then went on to Miyun.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the jihai new moon of the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 駐蹕喜峰口。

translations.literal: The Emperor halted at Xifeng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: He encamped at Xifeng Pass.

sentences.zh: 戊申，至自喜峰口。

translations.literal: Day wushen: he returned from Xifeng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he returned from Xifeng Pass.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，太皇太后梓宮發京師，帝戎服從。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day gengchen: the Grand Empress Dowager's coffin departed the capital; the Emperor followed in martial dress.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengchen, the Grand Empress Dowager's coffin left the capital and the emperor followed in martial dress.

sentences.zh: 甲申，葬孝貞純皇后。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Empress Xiaozhenchun was interred.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Empress Xiaozhenchun was buried.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，至自昌平。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: he returned from Changping.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he returned from Changping.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, day jihai.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jihai.

sentences.zh: 錄應州功，敘廕升賞者五萬餘人。

translations.literal: Merit at Ying Prefecture was recorded; more than fifty thousand received hereditary privileges, promotions, and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards for Ying Prefecture were entered on the rolls: more than fifty thousand men received enfeoffment privileges, promotion, or bounty.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復如宣府。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: he again went to Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he went to Xuanfu again.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，如大同。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day yiyou: he went to Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou, he went to Datong.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，次偏頭關。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day gengzi: he halted at Piantou Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengzi, he stopped at Piantou Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，敕曰：「總督軍務威武大將軍總兵官硃壽親統六師，肅清邊境，特加封鎮國公，歲支祿米五千石。

translations.literal: Day guichou: an edict read: "Supreme Commander of Military Affairs, Valiant-and-Awesome Grand General, and Commander-in-Chief Zhu Shou has personally led the six armies and pacified the frontier. He is specially ennobled as Duke of the State-Pacifier, with five thousand piculs of stipend grain yearly.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict declared: "Supreme Commander of Military Affairs, Valiant-and-Awesome Grand General, and Commander-in-Chief Zhu Shou has personally led the six armies and cleared the frontier. He is specially enfeoffed as Duke of the State-Pacifier with five thousand piculs of stipend grain a year.

sentences.zh: 吏部如敕奉行。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel is to carry out the edict as commanded.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel shall execute the edict as written.

sentences.zh: 」甲寅，封硃彬為平虜伯，硃泰為安邊伯。

translations.literal: The edict closed. Day jiayin: Zhu Bin was enfeoffed as Earl Who Pacifies the Barbarians and Zhu Tai as Earl Who Pacifies the Border.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Zhu Bin was made Earl Who Pacifies the Barbarians and Zhu Tai Earl Who Pacifies the Border.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，渡河。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, day wuchen: he crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuchen, he crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 己卯，次榆林。

translations.literal: Day jimao: he halted at Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he stopped at Yulin.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，調西官廳及四衛營兵赴宣、大。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day gengzi: troops of the Western Official Hall and the four guard battalions were transferred to Xuanfu and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengzi, Western Official Hall troops and men of the four guard battalions were shifted to Xuanfu and Datong.

sentences.zh: 壬子，次綏德，幸總兵官戴欽第。

translations.literal: Day renzi: he halted at Suide and visited the residence of Commander-in-Chief Dai Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he stopped at Suide and visited the home of Commander Dai Qin.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，渡河，幸石州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day wuyin: he crossed the river and visited Shizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuyin, he crossed the river and went to Shizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，次太原。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: he halted at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he stopped at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、天方、瓦剌入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Tianfang, and Oirat presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu, Tianfang, and the Oirats sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月丙申朔，帝在太原。

translations.literal: On the bingshen new moon of the first month of spring in Zhengde year fourteen the Emperor was at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen new moon of the first month in Zhengde fourteen the emperor was at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，改卜郊。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the date of the suburban sacrifice was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the suburban sacrifice was rescheduled.

sentences.zh: 壬子，還宣府。

translations.literal: Day renzi: he returned to Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he returned to Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，至自宣府。

translations.literal: In the second month, day renshen: he returned from Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renshen, he came back from Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，大祀天地於南郊，遂獵于南海子。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Heaven and Earth were grandly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb; he then hunted at the Nanhai Park.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he performed the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth, then hunted in the Nanhai Park.

sentences.zh: 是日，京師地震。

translations.literal: That day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the capital was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己丑，帝自加太師，諭禮部曰：「總督軍務威武大將軍總兵官太師鎮國公硃壽將巡兩畿、山東，祀神祈福，其具儀以聞。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the Emperor added to himself the title Grand Preceptor and instructed the Ministry of Rites: "Supreme Commander of Military Affairs, Valiant-and-Awesome Grand General, Commander-in-Chief, Grand Preceptor, and Duke of the State-Pacifier Zhu Shou will tour the two Metropolitan Regions and Shandong to offer sacrifice to the gods and pray for blessings; prepare the rites and report.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the emperor added to himself the title Grand Preceptor and told the Ministry of Rites: "Supreme Commander of Military Affairs, Valiant-and-Awesome Grand General, Commander-in-Chief, Grand Preceptor, and Duke of the State-Pacifier Zhu Shou will tour the two metropolitan regions and Shandong to sacrifice to the gods and pray for blessings; draw up the rites and report."

sentences.zh: 」三月癸丑，以諫巡幸，下兵部郎中黃鞏六人於錦衣衛獄，跪修撰舒芬百有七人於午門五日。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guichou, for remonstrating against the imperial tour, six persons including Huang Gong, Bureau Director in the Ministry of War, were sent to Jinyiwei prison; one hundred and seven persons including Compiler Shu Fen were made to kneel at the Meridian Gate for five days.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guichou, for counsel against the southern tour, six officials led by Huang Gong, a bureau director in the Ministry of War, were cast into Jinyiwei prison, and one hundred and seven scholars led by Compiler Shu Fen were ordered to kneel at the Meridian Gate for five days.

sentences.zh: 金吾衛都指揮僉事張英自刃以諫，衛士奪刃，得不死，鞫治，杖殺之。

translations.literal: Zhang Ying, Vice Commander of the Gold Brocade Guard, cut his own throat to remonstrate; guards seized the blade and he did not die; after trial he was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ying, vice commander of the Gold Brocade Guard, stabbed himself in remonstrance; guards wrested away the blade and he survived, but after trial he was beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，下寺正周敘、行人司副余廷瓚、主事林大輅三十三人於錦衣衛獄。

translations.literal: On yimao, Court of Penalties Director Zhou Xu, Ministry of Rites Junior Clerk Yu Tingzan, and Principal Clerk Lin Dayu—thirty-three persons in all—were sent to Jinyiwei prison.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Zhou Xu, director of the Court of Penalties, Yu Tingzan, junior clerk in the Ministry of Rites, Lin Dayu, a principal clerk, and thirty others were sent to Jinyiwei prison.

sentences.zh: 戊午，杖舒芬等百有七人于闕下。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Shu Fen and the other one hundred and seven were beaten below the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Shu Fen and the other one hundred and seven were flogged below the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 是日，風霾晝晦。

translations.literal: That day, wind and dust darkened the sky at midday.
translations.idiomatic: That day a dust storm darkened the sky at noon.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，免南畿被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiazi, grain taxes in the disaster-stricken Southern Metropolitan Region were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jiazi of the fourth month, grain levies were forgiven in the disaster-stricken Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，杖黃鞏等三十九人于闕下，先後死者十一人。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Huang Gong and thirty-eight others were beaten below the palace gate; eleven died in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Huang Gong and thirty-eight others were flogged below the palace gate; eleven died in the aftermath.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，詔山東、山西、陝西、河南、湖廣流民歸業者，官給廩食、廬舍、牛種，復五年。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jihai, an edict commanded that displaced persons from Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, and Huguang who returned to their occupations should be given official grain rations, lodging, and oxen and seed, with tax relief for five years.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jihai, an edict ordered that vagrants from Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, and Huguang who returned to farming receive government grain, shelter, and oxen and seed, with five years' tax relief.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，甯王宸濠反，巡撫江西右副都御史孫燧、南昌兵備副使許逵死之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingzi, the Prince of Ning, Zhu Chenhao, rebelled; Sun Sui, Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Jiangxi, and Xu Kui, Vice Commissioner for Military Affairs at Nanchang, died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingzi, Zhu Chenhao, Prince of Ning, rose in rebellion; Sun Sui, right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Jiangxi, and Xu Kui, vice commissioner for military affairs at Nanchang, were killed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，陷南康。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Nankang fell.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Nankang fell.

sentences.zh: 己卯，陷九江。

translations.literal: On jimao, Jiujiang fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Jiujiang fell.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，帝自將討宸濠，安邊伯硃泰為威武副將軍。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiachen, the Emperor personally led a campaign against Chenhao; Zhu Tai, Baron of Pacifying the Frontier, was made Vice General of Martial Prestige.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on jiachen of the seventh month, the Emperor took the field in person against Chenhao; Zhu Tai, Baron of Pacifying the Frontier, was made vice general of martial prestige.

sentences.zh: 帥師為先鋒。

translations.literal: He led the army as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: He led the army as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 丙午，宸濠犯安慶，都指揮楊銳、知府張文錦禦卻之。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Chenhao attacked Anqing; Regional Commander Yang Rui and Prefect Zhang Wenjin repelled him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Chenhao attacked Anqing; Regional Commander Yang Rui and Prefect Zhang Wenjin drove him back.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，提督南贛汀漳軍務副都御史王守仁帥兵復南昌。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Wang Shouren, Vice Censor-in-Chief supervising military affairs in southern Ganzhou, Tingzhou, and Zhangzhou, led troops and recovered Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Wang Shouren, vice censor-in-chief supervising military affairs in southern Ganzhou, Tingzhou, and Zhangzhou, marched in and retook Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，守仁敗宸濠於樵舍，擒之。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Shouren defeated Chenhao at Qiaoshe and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Shouren routed Chenhao at Qiaoshe and took him prisoner.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，車駕發京師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guiwei, the imperial carriage set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiwei, the imperial procession left the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，次涿州，王守仁捷奏至，秘不發。

translations.literal: On dinghai, he halted at Zhuozhou; Shouren's victory memorial arrived, but it was kept secret and not announced.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, he halted at Zhuozhou; Shouren's victory memorial arrived, but the court kept it secret and did not announce it.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙巳，漁於清江浦。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on yisi, he fished at Qingjiang Ford.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on yisi of the eleventh month, he went fishing at Qingjiang Ford.

sentences.zh: 壬子，冬至，受賀于太監張陽第。

translations.literal: On renzi, the winter solstice; congratulations were received at the residence of the eunuch Zhang Yang.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the winter solstice, he accepted congratulations at the home of the eunuch Zhang Yang.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，次揚州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, he halted at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, he halted at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，渡江。

translations.literal: On yiyou, he crossed the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, he crossed the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，至南京。

translations.literal: On bingxu, he reached Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, he reached Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 是歲，淮、揚饑，人相食。

translations.literal: That year, Huai and Yang suffered famine; men ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: That year famine struck Huai and Yang; people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Samarkand sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月庚寅朔，帝在南京。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, spring, the first month, on gengyin, the new year's day; the Emperor was at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, on the new year's day, gengyin of the first month, the Emperor was at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，改卜郊。

translations.literal: On guisi, the suburban sacrifice was rescheduled.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the suburban sacrifice was postponed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，振淮、揚諸府饑。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiwei, famine relief was extended to the Huai and Yang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jiwei of the fourth month, famine relief was extended to the Huai and Yang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingsi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingsi.

sentences.zh: 次牛首山，諸軍夜驚。

translations.literal: He halted at Niushou Mountain; the army panicked in the night.
translations.idiomatic: He halted at Niushou Mountain, and the army panicked in the night.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，小王子犯大同、宣府。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Small Prince raided Datong and Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, the Small Prince raided Datong and Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，免江西稅糧。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guiwei, grain taxes in Jiangxi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiwei, grain levies in Jiangxi were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸巳，受江西俘。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on guisi, Jiangxi captives were presented.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guisi, Jiangxi captives were presented.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，發南京。

translations.literal: On dingyou, he set out from Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, he departed Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，次鎮江，幸大學士楊一清第，臨故大學士靳貴喪。

translations.literal: On guimao, he halted at Zhenjiang, visited the residence of Grand Secretary Yang Yiqing, and attended the funeral of the late Grand Secretary Jin Gui.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, he halted at Zhenjiang, called at Grand Secretary Yang Yiqing's house, and attended the obsequies of the late Grand Secretary Jin Gui.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，漁于積水池，舟覆，救免，遂不豫。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jisi, he fished on Accumulated Water Pond; the boat capsized, he was rescued, and thereafter fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi, he went fishing on Accumulated Water Pond; the boat overturned, he was pulled out alive, and thereafter fell ill.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌，次通州。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on gengxu, he halted at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on gengxu of the tenth month, he halted at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，治交通宸濠者罪，執吏部尚書陸完赴行在。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengshen, those who had communicated with Chenhao were punished; Minister of Personnel Lu Wan was seized and sent to the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengshen, those who had dealt with Chenhao were punished; Minister of Personnel Lu Wan was arrested and brought to the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，宸濠伏誅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jichou, Chenhao was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jichou, Chenhao was put to death.

sentences.zh: 甲午，還京師，告捷於郊廟社稷。

translations.literal: On jiawu, he returned to the capital and reported victory at the suburban altars and the state temples.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, he returned to the capital and announced victory at the suburban altars and the state temples.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On dingyou, he performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, he performed the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 初獻疾作，不克成禮。

translations.literal: At the first offering his illness seized him, and he could not complete the rite.
translations.idiomatic: At the first offering his illness seized him, and he could not finish the rite.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、占城、佛郎機、土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Champa, Franks, and Turfan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys came from Ryukyu, Champa, the Franks, and Turfan.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月癸亥，改卜郊。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, spring, the first month, on guihai, the suburban sacrifice was rescheduled.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, on guihai of the first month, the suburban sacrifice was postponed.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，巡撫雲南副都御史何孟春討平彌勒州苗。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jihai, He Mengchun, Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Yunnan, campaigned and pacified the Miao of Mile Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai, He Mengchun, vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Yunnan, campaigned and pacified the Miao of Mile Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guichou, the new year's day; there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the new year's day of the third month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚申，改西宮廳為威武團營。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the Western Palace Office was renamed the Martial Prestige Regiment.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Western Palace Office was renamed the Martial Prestige Regiment.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大漸，諭司禮監曰：「朕疾不可為矣。

translations.literal: On yichou, his illness grew critical; he charged the Directorate of Ceremonial, saying: "My illness cannot be cured.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, his illness turned critical; he instructed the Directorate of Ceremonial, saying, "My sickness cannot be cured.

sentences.zh: 其以朕意達皇太后，天下事重，與閣臣審處之。

translations.literal: Convey my intent to the Empress Dowager; affairs of the realm are weighty—let the Grand Secretaries deliberate and settle them with care.
translations.idiomatic: Carry my wishes to the Empress Dowager. The realm's affairs are weighty; let the Grand Secretaries weigh them and decide with care.

sentences.zh: 前事皆由朕誤，非汝曹所能預也。

translations.literal: All that went before was my error, not something you could have foreseen.
translations.idiomatic: What went before was all my fault, not something you could have prevented.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，崩于豹房，年三十有一。

translations.literal: On bingyin, he died in the Leopard Quarters, aged thirty-one.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he died in the Leopard Quarters, aged thirty-one.

sentences.zh: 遺詔召興獻王長子嗣位。

translations.literal: His testament summoned the eldest son of the Prince of Xing to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: His testament summoned the eldest son of the Prince of Xing to succeed.

sentences.zh: 罷威武團營，遣還各邊軍，革京城內外皇店，放豹房番僧及教坊司樂人。

translations.literal: The Martial Prestige Regiment was abolished, frontier troops were sent back, imperial shops inside and outside the capital were abolished, and the foreign monks of the Leopard Quarters and the musicians of the Music Office were released.
translations.idiomatic: The Martial Prestige Regiment was abolished, frontier troops were sent home, imperial shops inside and outside the capital were shut down, and the foreign monks of the Leopard Quarters and the musicians of the Music Office were released.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，頒遺詔於天下，釋系囚，還四方所獻婦女，停不急工役，收宣府行宮金寶還內庫。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the testament was promulgated throughout the realm; prisoners were released, women presented from the four quarters were sent home, non-urgent labor levies were halted, and the gold and jewels of the Xuanfu traveling palace were gathered back into the inner treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the testament was promulgated throughout the realm; prisoners were freed, women sent as tribute from the provinces were returned home, non-urgent labor levies were halted, and the gold and jewels of the Xuanfu traveling palace were gathered back into the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 庚午，執江彬等下獄。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Jiang Bin and others were seized and sent to prison.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Jiang Bin and his associates were arrested and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 世宗入立。

translations.literal: Shizong entered and took the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong entered the capital and took the throne.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，上尊諡，廟號武宗，葬康陵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiwei, posthumous titles were granted; the temple name Wuzong was bestowed, and he was buried at Kangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiwei, posthumous honors were granted, the temple name Wuzong was bestowed, and he was buried at Kangling.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：明自正統以來，國勢浸弱。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Since the Zhengtong reign the Ming state's strength has gradually weakened.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Since the Zhengtong reign the strength of the Ming state has gradually waned.

sentences.zh: 毅皇手除逆瑾，躬禦邊寇，奮然欲以武功自雄。

translations.literal: Yihuang personally removed the traitor Jin, took the field himself against border enemies, and eagerly sought to make his martial prowess his glory.
translations.idiomatic: Yihuang personally destroyed the traitor Jin, took the field himself against border raiders, and burned to make his martial fame his boast.

sentences.zh: 然耽樂嬉遊，暱近群小，至自署官號，冠履之分蕩然矣。

translations.literal: Yet he indulged in pleasure and roaming, drew close to petty men, went so far as to title himself with offices—and the distinction of cap and shoe was utterly undone.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he gave himself to pleasure and roaming, clung to petty men, went so far as to invent his own titles—and the distinction between ruler and subject was utterly undone.

sentences.zh: 猶幸用人之柄躬自操持，而秉鈞諸臣補苴匡救，是以朝綱紊亂，而不底於危亡。

translations.literal: Yet fortunately he still held the power of appointing men in his own hands, and the grand secretaries patched and set things right—so though court order was tangled, the dynasty did not tip into ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he still kept the power of appointment in his own hands, and the grand secretaries patched and pulled the realm back—so though court order was tangled, the dynasty did not fall into ruin.

sentences.zh: 假使承孝宗之遺澤，制節謹度，有中主之操，則國泰而名完，豈至重後人之訾議哉！

translations.literal: Had he inherited Xiaozong's legacy, kept measure and restraint, and possessed the conduct of a middling ruler, the realm would have been secure and his name intact—how would he have earned such heavy blame from later generations!
translations.idiomatic: Had he inherited Xiaozong's legacy, kept measure and restraint, and shown the conduct of a middling ruler, the realm would have been secure and his name whole—how would he have drawn such heavy blame from later ages!
